nodes.trans: Welcome! Are you looking for anything?

nodes.text: 네, 편하게 보세요. 필요하신 거 있으면 불러 주세요.
nodes.pron: ne, pyeonhage boseyo. piryohasin geo isseumyeon bulleo juseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, take your time. Call me if you need anything.

replies.trans: Is anything on sale right now?

nodes.text: 네, 이쪽 옷은 전부 삼십 퍼센트 할인이에요.
nodes.pron: ne, ijjok oseun jeonbu samsip peosenteu harinieyo.
nodes.trans: Yes, everything over here is thirty percent off.

replies.trans: Nice. Do you have coats too?

nodes.trans: The sweaters are over here. What color are you looking for?

replies.trans: Do you have it in black?

nodes.text: 코트는 이쪽이에요. 평소에 어떤 사이즈 입으세요?
nodes.pron: koteuneun ijjogieyo. pyeongsoe eotteon saijeu ibeuseyo?
nodes.trans: The coats are this way. What size do you usually wear?

replies.trans: I'm not sure. Maybe a large?

nodes.text: 이건 검은색이랑 네이비가 있어요. 사이즈는 어떻게 드릴까요?
nodes.pron: igeon geomeunsaegirang neibiga isseoyo. saijeuneun eotteoke deurilkkayo?
nodes.trans: This one comes in black and navy. What size would you like?

replies.trans: Do you have a large in black?

nodes.text: 죄송해요, 검은색 엘은 품절이에요. 네이비는 아직 있어요.
nodes.pron: joesonghaeyo, geomeunsaek ereun pumjeorieyo. neibineun ajik isseoyo.
nodes.trans: Sorry, the black one in large is sold out. We still have navy.

nodes.text: 여기 있습니다. 한번 입어 보시겠어요? 피팅룸은 저쪽이에요.
nodes.pron: yeogi itseumnida. hanbeon ibeo bosigesseoyo? pitingrumeun jeojjogieyo.
nodes.trans: Here you go. Would you like to try it on? The fitting room is over there.

replies.trans: No, that's okay. How much is it?

nodes.trans: How is it? Does it fit well?

replies.text: 좀 끼네요. 한 치수 큰 거 있어요?
replies.pron: jom kkineyo. han chisu keun geo isseoyo?
replies.trans: It's a bit tight. Do you have one size up?

nodes.text: 네, 한 치수 큰 거예요. 이걸로 입어 보세요.
nodes.pron: ne, han chisu keun geoyeyo. igeollo ibeo boseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, this is one size up. Try this one.

replies.text: 그래도 잘 안 맞네요. 다음에 올게요.
replies.pron: geuraedo jal an manneyo. daeume olgeyo.
replies.trans: It still doesn't fit right. I'll come back another time.

nodes.text: 이건 칠만 원인데요, 이번 주에 이십 퍼센트 할인돼요.
nodes.pron: igeon chilman wonindeyo, ibeon jue isip peosenteu harindwaeyo.
nodes.trans: This one is seventy thousand won, but it's twenty percent off this week.

replies.trans: I'll think about it and come back.

nodes.text: 이건 사만 원이에요. 대신 조금 얇아요.
nodes.pron: igeon saman wonieyo. daesin jogeum yalbayo.
nodes.trans: This one is forty thousand won. It's a little thinner, though.

nodes.text: 저는 처음 거 추천드려요. 더 따뜻하고 품질도 좋아요.
nodes.pron: jeoneun cheoeum geo chucheondeuryeoyo. deo ttatteutago pumjildo joayo.
nodes.trans: I'd recommend the first one. It's warmer and the quality is better.

replies.trans: Thank you. I'll think about it.

nodes.trans: Sure, I'll ring you up. Card or cash?
Do you need a bag? Would you like the receipt too?

replies.trans: No bag, thanks. Just the receipt, please.

nodes.trans: Here you are. Thank you, come again!

nodes.text: 네, 괜찮아요! 언제든지 또 들러 주세요.
nodes.pron: ne, gwaenchanayo! eonjedeunji tto deulleo juseyo.
nodes.trans: Sure, no problem! Drop by again anytime.
